Kerala Health Minister Bans Political Activities in Hospitals

The Kerala Health Minister has announced a ban on political activities within government hospitals. This decision aims to ensure a conducive environment for patient care and hospital operations. The move comes amid concerns about disruptions caused by political engagements in healthcare facilities.
